R01.quote: `ArgumentError: wrong number of arguments (given 0, expected 1..2)` when the class loads... `enum :status, { draft: 0, ready: 1 }, prefix: true`... including the status filter and `status_ready` scope tests.
R01.reasons: Validation relies on suite results and named tests. It does not persist distinct draft and ready notes and then exercise the helpers after a reload.

R02.quote: The repair needs 7.1 or later, so it ships with the bump... `serialize :tags, coder: JSON`... asserts `["provincial life", "Victorian", "reform"]` round-trips.
R02.reasons: There is a single round-trip test. Reloading existing unequal JSON, comma-separated input and checking the stored representation are all absent.

R03.reasons: The probe covers update, reload and validation errors. It does not check form rendering or that existing settings are preserved.

R04.quote: `PG::UndefinedColumn: ERROR: column notes.notebooks does not exist`... `@notes = @notes.where(notebook: @notebook)`
R04.reasons: Only the existing filter and pagination tests are cited. There is no unequal-population, exclusion or foreign-notebook denial scenario.

R05.quote:
receipt CSVs come out as `"title,doi
On idleness,
Of experience,
"` with the DOIs missing... `csv << [ note.title, citation&.doi ]`
R05.reasons: A model probe stands in for applying a real import and comparing the downloaded receipt to persisted citations.

R06.quote: On 7.2 and later, `return false` commits the transaction... raise ActiveRecord::Rollback unless saved
R06.reasons: The probe forces save to return false instead of running a real apply request with an invalid row and checking fresh PostgreSQL counts. A success control is included.

R07.quote: `TypeError: String can't be coerced into Integer`. Every Markdown export job fails... `finish(fragments.join)`
R07.reasons: Exports tests check the exact body, but the plan does not say a real worker ran them, and there is no failed-export control.

R08.quote: `annotations[row.line]` (an Integer) returns `nil`. The annotation disappears from the import preview... `<% annotations = @import.annotations %>`
R08.reasons: It checks one annotation lookup and one test. Unequal annotations at lines 2 and 4 and a multiline CSV row are missing.

R11.quote: produces "Your reading digest for October 04, 2026" instead of October 05, and it queries the wrong day's notes... `requested_at = requested_at.in_time_zone("UTC")`
R11.reasons: Validation uses a controller test and a deserialization probe. There is no real JSON queue/worker run crossing each midnight separately, and no inspection of reservation keys.

R12.quote: A 7.0 worker raises `ActiveJob::DeserializationError: … BigDecimalSerializer is not known`... `DigestJob.perform_later(self, requested_at, reading_completion.to_s)`
R12.reasons: There is a payload probe and a proposed staging drill, but not the full producer/consumer matrix with same-version controls and the exact delivered percentage.

R13.quote: `NoMethodError: undefined method 'utc' for an instance of Integer` when enqueuing... `set(wait_until: Time.at(reminder_epoch))`
R13.reasons: It asserts the enqueued job's :at value, but not the persisted schedule time or the replacement and ownership controls.

R14.quote: the job raises instead of retrying 3 times, so a "fetching" citation never records its failure... `wait: :polynomially_longer`
R14.reasons: The persistent-503 test is cited, but the 503->200 and 401 controls are missing.

R15.reasons: It asserts the form's attributes, but does not submit the form or check field names and the resulting note membership.

R16.quote:
get "/notes", to: "notes#index", as: :notes
get "/journal", to: "notes#index", as: :journal
R16.reasons: It relies on a route listing and a named test, not owner requests to both URLs showing identical authorized list behavior.

R17.quote: The repair needs 7.1 or later; on 7.0 the symbol `:none` would be truthy. Ships with the bump.
R17.reasons: Only the RecordNotFound tests are cited. There is no raised request exception and no check of the CI eager-loading mode.

R18.reasons: Boot and details/summary are checked. Attachment rendering is not, and the script, handler and javascript-URL exclusions are only proposed or absent.

R19.reasons: There are no special-character credentials, no fresh-process Basic header check and no bounded-failure check.

R09.quote: `expires_in: [export.expires_at - Time.current, 1].max`. Ships on 7.0. Why not `cache_if export.downloadable?`: ... broke `exports_controller_test.rb:59`
R09.reasons: Validation is only the defaults-8.1 suite run. Before/after-deadline cached and fresh reads and download expiry/ownership checks are not specified.

R20.quote: `serialize :preferences, coder: YAML` (7.1+). The stored YAML stays readable.
R20.reasons: It cites only the defaults suite run. Creating, editing and reloading unequal preferences and the export heading with the gate both off and on are not specified.

R21.quote: `params.require(:notebook).permit(:name, :export_heading)`... The probe renamed a notebook and the slug stayed `"probe-book"`.
R21.reasons: It does not test creation or an attempted slug change explicitly.

R23.quote: `Date.iso8601(day)` raises `TypeError: no implicit conversion of Date into String`... `[day.to_date, count]`
R23.reasons: The probe compares versions rather than decoding off/on, and empty-report and ownership controls are missing.

R25.quote: The ETag is the blob checksum, so behavior is equivalent. Not verified by a request with mismatched headers.
R25.reasons: Impact: the plan says behavior is equivalent, but the gate turns a 200-with-bytes into a 304. Recommendation: there is no keep/adopt decision. Validation: only one mismatched-header test is proposed, with no list-order, expired-302 or foreign-404 cases.
